July–August close conclusion — September operating review

- July and August strengthen the operating-durability read: Evergreen usage remained within one standard Growth overage band (228 MAD in July; 236 in August); August AWS was about $18.9k and Pinecone about $4.2k; Acme stayed in normal API v2 support with no timeout recurrence or data-loss report.

Compass remains internal evidence (8 surfaced; 5 completed; 2 rejected as thin; 1 awaiting customer follow-up), not customer behavior proof or repeatability beyond the current accounts.
- Conclusion: this evidence supports continuing retention, standard-term customer work, monthly vendor hygiene, and reliable Mercury/Atlas execution. It does not change fall financing posture or support a staffing revisit; no market-warming, investor/data-room work, or hiring reopen from this review.
- Keep Compass narrow and internal; any broader claim requires stronger evidence beyond Evergreen and the current owner workflow.
